readings.Aries: The obstacle is smaller than your reaction to it suggests. Recalibrate the response. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Taurus: What feels like stability might be stagnation. It is worth sitting with the discomfort of not knowing. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: The misunderstanding is small and fixable. Left alone, it won't stay small. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Cancer: You are capable of a fierceness in protection that surprises people who only know your softness. Both are you. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Leo: Something you've been holding as a personal failure is a shared one. Stop carrying it alone. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Virgo: You've been adjusting yourself to fit a space that doesn't fit you. That adjustment has a cost. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Libra: Not everything can be fair. Some things are just what they are. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Scorpio: The power you gave away — take it back. Slowly and without announcement. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Sagittarius: The truth you're telling is true. It is not the whole truth. Find the rest of it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Capricorn: You are further along than you think. The metric you're using is incorrect. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Aquarius: The relationship that doesn't fit your system is the one that's teaching you something important. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Pisces: The current is strong today. You can swim with it and choose your direction within it. Sleep on it before committing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
